status: Prepared, not submitted and not GPU validated
purpose: Test whether same-state spectral response to axis-separated SEGA gain interventions is measurable and predicts smaller interventions. No efficacy claim.
backbone: FLUX.1-Krea-dev transformer 8162a9c7b05a641be098422bf2fcf335615c2f28 with FLUX.1-dev text encoders/VAE
controls: One middle occupied RoPE octave per spatial axis, sorted by exponent, with exact affected-axis query/key RMS preservation; plus a shared spatial scalar control. Index axis unchanged. Do not reapply SEGA's minimum-one clipping after the perturbation; this is a local intervention with positive gains, not a selected sampling method.
acceptance_for_interpretation: Unperturbed same-state velocity replay must be bitwise identical.
Final baseline and instrumented trajectory endpoints and gain histories must be bitwise/exactly equal.
All prespecified steps and forward calls must be accounted for.
analysis: Report signed Jacobian, cross-axis response fraction, and held-aside half-step residual relative to the zero-change predictor. Inspect response size and numerical precision. No automatic candidate selection or confirmation. Three controls do not identify the whole reachable subspace.

planned_allocation.basis: Prior generation approximately215 seconds/28-step4K image; approximate constant forward cost plus model loads and smoke. Not a benchmark or exact SU conversion.

Run login guard and check taccinfo before submission; respect96percent burn stop.
Prepare two distinct task files under taskq_response and register actual job ID and task paths with the watcher before waiting.
Do not leave a second unmonitored job or consume fresh64.

prior_art.checked: Sections4.1-4.2; released allocation at ddaab08552c7b7ceba2ebd8f579a0f65dee90b5e in flux_sega/transformer_flux.py lines103-154 and feature projection near691-746.
prior_art.finding: SEGA maps projected-feature spectral profiles to per-pair gains using a fixed centered nonlinear allocation and clipping. The inspected allocation does not estimate a same-state model response. This is a narrow implementation distinction, not proof of novelty.

prior_art.checked: Section4 and Algorithm1, AppendixE; no official implementation link established in this inspection.
prior_art.finding: SCG modifies latent Fourier magnitudes after the sampling update toward a time-dependent reference, retaining phase. It does not use the attention-gain actuator in its presented algorithm. Its common spectral-control objective remains a direct related-work boundary; absence of a published Jacobian in this algorithm is not an exhaustive novelty search.
